searchText: Wonder if others are still experiencing this? Or if there are any Sepolia peers that are up that I could connect to directly? Occasionally have to restart the client to refresh the peers, but I can usually sync (this is besu not geth) Ya we can also sync, but I think peer discovery takes a while? How long does it take you to find peers and start receiving headers on Sepolia w/o adding any trusted nodes? It’s quite variable, sometimes no problem, sometimes takes a day or so (with no intervention)
